title: Visayas Grid on Yellow Alert as Toledo Thermal Plant Goes Offline
detail: NGCP placed the Visayas grid under yellow alert from 5 to 6 p.m. on Nov 16 with 2,774 MW available against a 2,636 MW peak demand, triggered by the unavailability of a Toledo Power thermal plant. On Nov 17 the DOE said it does not expect red or yellow alerts for the rest of 2026 provided power plants sustain operations.

media.caption: Visayas grid placed under yellow alert on Nov 16
